processOutput.description:
The outputs of {@link MlPipe#process}. The inputs to {@link MlPipe#process} are the inputs to
{@link MlInterpreter#interpret}.

interpretations.description:
The result of applying an {@link MlInterpreter#explainer} on an {@link MlPipe}. The interpretation results
here should have one-to-one correspondence with elements of {@link #processOutput}. For example, this
should not hold aggregated interpretations for the "batch" of inputs provided to the interpret function, and this
should not hold global interpretations.

Developer Note: since this represents the result of local interpretability, it is recommended to have individual
elements of the interpretations be relatable/traceable to individual elements of DO. For example, if both are {@link Data},
then the index should match.

title:
This type encapsulates the result of interpreting an {@link MlPipe} using the SHAP Python library. In addition to
the base artifacts of an interpretation result, this type holds the expected value of the pipe's native model's
output. This expected value is required for analyzing the output of an {@link ShapInterpreter}.

An example of an explanation of a single-class prediction (note: the shape is different than native shap):
```
subject || sepal length | sepal width | petal length | petal width | bias
asset0       -0.1          -0.4             -0.2         -0.3        1.0
asset1       0.75          -0.15            -0.3         -0.3        1.0
asset2       -0.333        2.333            -0.333       -0.666      1.0
asset3       -0.1          -0.4             -0.2         -0.3        1.0
```

An example of an explanation of a multi-class prediction:
```
subject | class || sepal length | sepal width | petal length | petal width | bias
asset0     0         -0.1          -0.4             -0.2         -0.3        1.0
asset0     1         -0.25         -0.15            -0.1         -0.0        0.5
asset0     2         1.25          0.15             0.1          -0.0        -0.5
asset1     0         -0.333        0.333            -0.333       -0.666      1.0
asset1     1         -0.1          0.4              -0.1         -0.2        0.5
asset1     2         0.1           0.6              0.1          0.2        -0.5
```
name: ShapInterpretResult
